content: DPP (UK broadcaster consortium) publishes AQC (Automated QC) + eyeball QC guidelines built on EBU tolerance definitions, delivered as a PDF report per programme; AS-11/RDD-59 (DPP+IMF) mandate specific technical and editorial MXF metadata. This is delivery-spec conformance ('is this file spec-legal for this broadcaster'), a categorically different question from mediadiff's 'did this build change the output' — same checks (loudness, black frames, color range) can appear in both but the pass condition differs: fixed spec threshold vs. baseline-relative delta.
